Therefore, while semantically aligned, it is structurally non-conformant. The score is slightly above 0 because the general gestalt is recognizable, unlike a complete hallucination.

The headstock is melted/unrecognizable (severity ~4.2), the neck fuses into the body without a joint (severity ~4.5), and the player's hand merges with the fretboard (severity ~4.0). These defects compound to result in a very low artifact score.
